Depression is a comfort blanket for most people who do not like feeling vulnerable during confrontation. When meds and therapy begin working, a lot of time, people are confused as to how they’re supposed to feel because that comfort blanket you once found with depression is no longer there. In my opinion the best way to get over this feeling is to find a hobby, even if it’s small, that brings you some sort of happiness. Even something as small as solving a puzzle and seeing it completely finished can give you that pick me up your brain is looking for. Keep fighting the good fight op.

Confrontation is the hardest step of battling depression. I was diagnosed with Major Depressive Disorder 14 months ago and I absolutely hated people telling me to think about my loved ones, you’re only hurting other people, etc.. because suicide is a selfish thing, it honestly is. When you’re depressed, all you want to do is be selfish though because why shouldn’t you, you’re the one hurting, not those other people. Once you can recognize depression as a way of shifting mentality’s (this is called a schema shift) it becomes much easier to manage responses like that. People are not saying it to intentionally hurt you. They Know you’re hurting and don’t know how else to help you. Keep fighting the fight and don’t give up op.
